entries.zh: 苦求；苦苦哀求（恳切祈求）
entries.en: to implore earnestly; to beg piteously
to plead and complain bitterly; to lament one's wrongs
entries.notes: M 末组音 cou ziu 无对应汉字，词义据 H 苦訴 与 L 推定。

entries.zh: 揖让；打揖恳求（向尊长作揖求告）
entries.en: to bow deferentially in petition; I beg Your Honor
entries.notes: L 有 [疑:al m./a vm.]，敬称未定，词义据 H 揖讓。

entries.en: to plead for mercy; to intercede

entries.zh: 累算补足；补算亏缺（补一方之不足）
entries.en: to make up a shortfall; to reckon up cumulatively
entries.notes: L 词行拼写残乱（…dos fi tuir），词义据 H 累算 与 M lui gui 推定。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L/H 两栏均 [空]，M 第二词有刪劃且调号 T99 污損难辨，无从定夺。

entries.zh: 南；南方（词头有涂划，或指南方之星）
entries.en: south; southern star (headword partly smeared)
entries.notes: L 行首涂划、词头残乱（m. S wr.），据 H 南 与后条南斗星互证推定。

entries.zh: 南斗星；南斗（星宿名，居南天）
entries.en: the Southern Dipper (constellation); star of the south

entries.zh: 叹气；出气（气字单用，犹言叹息）
entries.en: to sigh; to let out breath
entries.notes: M 末音 cui 无对应汉字，主义据 H 氣 与 L suspírar。

entries.en: to breathe out; to emit (a sigh)
to sigh
to sigh with lament; to exclaim 'alas!'
to sigh with complaint; to breathe out one's grievance
entries.notes: L [疑:quexandose/quexandoce] 仅拼写之疑，词义不受影响。

entries.zh: 嗆嘆：哽噎叹息（疑即「嗟嘆」）
entries.en: to sigh amid choking sobs (probably = to sigh with lament)
entries.notes: H 嗆字与 suspírar 义不合，疑为「嗟」之误识，降中置信。

entries.en: to sigh; a sigh
to sigh; to heave sighs
to sigh with resentment; to lament regretfully

entries.zh: 叹算（字面罕用，或为「叹怨」之讹写）
entries.en: to sigh and reckon (unusual collocation; probably for 'sigh with resentment')
entries.notes: H 嘆算字面不成词，M zuan 与「算」相合，词义存疑降中。

entries.en: a dolorous sigh; to sigh plaintively

entries.zh: 养；养育（抚育儿女、维持生计）
entries.en: to sustain, nourish; to rear (children)
entries.notes: M 第二音 io 调号 T99 污損，词义据 L sustentar/criar 与 H 養（疑为養育）。
